description: Edits a saved coaching review's content in place (review_id, from read a staffer's events), as Edit does: the full new content (visit details, wentWell[], tier1[], tier2[] items with text and optional photos[], closing) and optional occurredOn. The body, thumbnails and content hash are recomputed from content; a change quietly marks a prior read-receipt stale. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: edit_coaching_review
title: Edit a coaching review
